description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'hist_gbm' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + histogram-based Gradient Boosting.
model: hist_gbm (TF-IDF word featurizer + histogram-based Gradient Boosting)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'hist_gbm', group(s): tree); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
